[KB-TARIFF-020 §1] Prepaid Plus add-ons (synthetic) - Streaming add-ons
Synthetic GCT Prepaid Plus customers can add the StreamMax add-on for 25 AED per month. Since October 2026 every streaming add-on also carries the 15 AED digital services fee, shown as a separate line on the bill.
</evidence>
Why did my synthetic GCT Prepaid Plus bill increase by 15 AED this month?
